About.title: A rental agency that answers at midnight
About.lead: ABC Rent a Car is a small agency from Sarajevo. We bring the car where you need it and pick up the phone even in the middle of the night.
About.intro2: Our fleet has city cars, SUVs, the Mercedes E-Class and vans for nine people. Every car has an automatic gearbox.
About.storyP1: We bring the car to wherever you need it: Sarajevo Airport or any address in Sarajevo, at no extra cost. Every vehicle is fully insured and regularly serviced.
About.storyP2: Besides car rental we offer a professional chauffeur service and airport transfers. You can book through the website, WhatsApp or by phone.

Faq.title: Frequently asked
Faq.lead: If you can't find the answer here, send us a WhatsApp message.

items.q: What do I need to rent a car?
items.a: A valid driving licence, an ID card or passport and a card for the deposit.
200 € for every car, except the Audi Q7 and Mercedes E-Class where it's 300 €. You get it back as soon as the car is returned in order.
Full insurance, unlimited mileage, delivery within Sarajevo Canton and roadside assistance.
Yes, free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup. A message or a call is enough.

items.q: Do you deliver to the airport?
items.a: Yes, to Sarajevo Airport and any address in Sarajevo Canton, at no extra cost.

items.q: What if I have an accident?
items.a: Call the police, then call us right away. Don't move the car until the police arrive, we'll guide you from there.
